rule: An undated person with no recorded death and no public source is treated as living when their NEAREST DATED ANCESTOR (their parents first, then grandparents, then great-grandparents, up to 3 generations, both lines) was born in year Y, g generations up, and Y + 20*g is 1946 or later, that is, 80 or younger in 2026; when several ancestors tie for nearest, the latest Y counts. An undated spouse of a person so treated is treated as living too. Only David can rule a person dead: ids he rules dead go in 'overridden'. 'byHand' lists people David asked to include although the estimate falls just short (an estimate of 1941 or 1945).
